description: TaxiGer Doc helps taxi operators, drivers and taxi business owners better understand Belgian taxi regulations, legal obligations and administrative procedures for rank taxis, street taxis and limousine services in Flanders, Brussels and Wallonia. Find official Chiron guides, information about the dienststaat, vervoerbewijs, route sheets, taxi licences, inspections and all mandatory taxi documents.
